summary: Direction redesign, pass 2 (reviewer fixes A-F) applied to the core doc: smaller nudges with a cap, sign-of-sum ending rule, re-signed balanced dir table, neutral situations, pool recount, win/loss order and rescue default.

direction.value: dir_<mkt>, int, reachable about -63..+63, hidden, both chains feed it
direction.modifiers: echo x1.25 (floor) if previous step of the same chain had the same sign; then late swing x1.5 (floor) at B3/B4 when |dir| >= 25 before the step and the nudge opposes the sign; then cap 14. Echo and swing stack in that order.
direction.ending: dir >= 0 good, dir < 0 bad; sign of the whole sum, no band, no last-nudge tiebreak; no step fired = good
direction.paths: 5 of 7 agreeing picks give a sure result, 3-4 can go either way; good share 50/49/52/54% (mil/lux/min/bio); B4 alone can flip the ending in about 40% of paths (|dir| within reach of zero), none in the other 60%
direction.pattern_checks: opt_a + in 14/28 (3,4,4,3); each step position 2 of 4; cash option + in 10/19; tech option + in 4/9; larger-bot-cut option + in 11/22
other_fixes: pool: 28 kept (EV01-16, EV17, EV19, EV20, EV21, EV22, EV24, EV25, EV26, EV28, BE01-BE03) + 12 new = 40; EV18 retired (fixes R9)
check order win, swept, bankrupt; rescue: repossession first, no stipend in a repossession cycle, only first two stipends paid (rescue_max 2), stipend never ends the run
timing: all effects at once, immediate result popup; Minerals chain A follow-ups kept as optional flavour popups only
names Ostrel Syndicate, Seam Alloy; tech goals 9/18/12; cross_load 1.5; tier schedule 13/27, 11/24, 14/28; median win 27-28; tier hits -1 only
core 4.3 now holds only id, trigger, neutral situation, dir; Gets/Costs/Bot live in economy 8.2
